Chapter 1042: 5: Chaos (Vote For Monthly Tickets)_3

Chapter 1042: Chapter 5: Chaos (Vote for Monthly Tickets)_3

Even if it’s just an incarnation, as long as the mind and will are strong enough, it can still unleash terrifying combat power.

“Just an incarnation—how much of your mind and will can it contain? How strong can the secret techniques it wields really be?” Lord Qingfen scoffed in disbelief.

“Qingfen, I’ve spent thirty thousand years weaving you a beautiful dream. Why don’t you come in and take a look?”

The voice of the woman with the violet dress overlapped heavily, echoing.

Lord Qingfen immediately sensed his consciousness beginning to descend into a haze.

“This isn’t good.”

“Your incarnation contains the Origin Source of your true self? How could you bear to do this?” Lord Qingfen’s eyes widened as he struggled to stay awake, resisting the pull into slumber.

Meanwhile, layers upon layers of a Spatial-Temporal Maze started to manifest in the surroundings. As his usual retreat for cultivation, it was naturally also the core area of Qingfen City’s formation coverage. With a single thought, he could activate the formation’s power to protect himself.

“Purple Dream, you can at most trap me for a hundred breaths of time.” Lord Qingfen glared at Marquis Purple Dream, even as his mind and will rapidly descended.

Before he completely fell into unconsciousness, Lord Qingfen had already transmitted messages to his many disciples and followers.

“A hundred breaths—that’s more than enough.”

Marquis Purple Dream stared at the now-slumbering Lord Qingfen.

Though the price she paid to trap Lord Qingfen for a hundred breaths was not small, her goal was never to kill him.

That was impossible. Protected by Qingfen City’s grand formation, a mere incarnation, even with seven or eight other peak Great Lord-level experts of the same tier, couldn’t touch him within a hundred breaths, let alone kill him.

Besides, even if the current Lord Qingfen was slain, he’d surely have life-preserving mechanisms and would not truly perish.

The stakes weren’t significant in that sense.

Marquis Purple Dream’s true strategy lay with the disciples equipped with the Myriad Formation Crystal, who had long infiltrated Qingfen City.

With Lord Qingfen’s consciousness thrown into slumber—not only the awareness of his true form but even his incarnated avatars—Qingfen City would become leaderless. A hundred breaths of time would suffice for the Myriad Formation Crystal to fully replicate the city’s formation structures.

…

Before falling completely into slumber, Lord Qingfen had already delivered instructions to his many disciples and subordinates.

“The Marquis wants us to head immediately to the formation’s core areas to guard them?”

Feng Wanxing and other dominator-level experts received Lord Qingfen’s urgent summons. Though perplexed, they hesitated not for a moment, promptly acting as per the prearranged protocol.

Not long before, Lord Qingfen had sensed something amiss. He had already warned Feng Wanxing and the dominator-level experts that if anything unexpected occurred, they were not to concern themselves with the rest of the city but instead guard the specific formation core zones.

In Lord Qingfen’s calculations, even under extreme circumstances—such as Marquis Purple Dream making a move—her aim would likely be to sabotage Qingfen City’s formation cores.

As long as the formation’s cores were protected, the grand formation of Qingfen City would remain intact, and the strategies of the Purple Dream Domain would naturally collapse on their own.

“Hmm?”

“Master said I shouldn’t leave?”

Lin Yuan also received Lord Qingfen’s final transmission. “His tone was so urgent—something must have gone wrong.”

Lin Yuan speculated inwardly, glancing outside the Sky Burning Court. “Since Master told me not to leave, I definitely won’t step outside.”

Lin Yuan actively operated the formation surrounding the Sky Burning Court. Normally, these formations ran in hidden mode, only triggering during emergencies. Taking a prudent approach, Lin Yuan ensured the formations ran at their highest defensive intensity outright.

This level of operation consumed significant energy, but after deducing that Lord Qingfen was likely in trouble, Lin Yuan disregarded such costs.

…

“Master has successfully stalled Lord Qingfen.”

The violet-haired woman received word, a hint of delight flashing across her features.

This operation by the Purple Dream Domain hinged on the critical point: whether Lord Qingfen could be stalled.

If he couldn’t be held back, then it would all amount to nothing—their emergence would only mean death.

“Only seventy breaths left.”

The violet-haired woman glanced at the other figures behind her.

Marquis Purple Dream was confident she could trap Lord Qingfen for over a hundred breaths, but they needed to reserve ample time to retreat from Qingfen City.

“Let’s begin.”

With a sweeping gesture from the violet-haired woman, hundreds of colossal figures materialized. These were all puppets at the pinnacle of dominator-level strength. Without a trace of life aura, they could evade detection by Qingfen City’s formation sensors.

Rumble—

Hundreds of peak dominator-level puppets began wreaking havoc within Qingfen City, drawing overt attention.

Meanwhile, the violet-haired woman and other strongholders concealed themselves, equipped with the Myriad Formation Crystals, and secretly set to replicating Qingfen City’s grand formation structures.

…

At one of the formation core zones.

The violet-haired woman and her allies appeared.

“Lord Qingfen’s disciples are guarding inside.” The violet-haired woman smiled faintly. “Truly worthy of being a peak Great Lord who has fought us in the Purple Dream Domain for years—he’s thought things through so thoroughly, even predicting our target might be the formation cores within the city.”

The other strongholders shared knowing grins.

Though Lord Qingfen had just been stalled, the disciples had promptly stationed themselves at the formation cores, clearly a precaution prepared in advance.

But unfortunately for them, armed with the Myriad Formation Crystal, there was no need to destroy the formation cores. They merely had to replicate them from afar and bring them back to be deciphered by the Ancient Country Formation Masters.

The effort to directly destroy the formation cores versus secretly replicating them from outside was leagues apart in difficulty.

The violet-haired woman and her allies spent just three breaths using the Myriad Formation Crystal to replicate this core’s structure, then quietly vanished.

The disciples guarding the formation core remained completely oblivious to the violet-haired woman and her team throughout.

Time continued to flow.

Twenty breaths quickly passed.

“We’ve already replicated six formation cores.”

The violet-haired woman was greatly satisfied. Everything had been proceeding smoothly—hundreds of puppets at the pinnacle of dominator-level strength were brazenly attracting Qingfen City’s attention on the surface.

Thus far, their path had encountered no hindrance.

Qingfen City had twelve formation core zones in total; they had already replicated nine within twenty breaths. Time remained comfortably ample.

“Let’s move to the next formation core.”

The violet-haired woman and her team immediately began rushing toward their next target.
